game: RM3E01 (Metroid Prime 3: Corruption, USA, disc 0, rev 0)
request: Inventory every Wiimote/Nunchuk motion the game can react to and give each a keyboard key ahead of play-testing.
method: The game's own motion analyser (0x803C0A24 ring + biquads, 0x803C0E40 deadband detectors, 0x803C11D8 swing bits, 0x803BE890 orientation windows, 0x803C31DC/0x803C3728 digital tilt gestures, 0x803C3B94/0x803C3C7C gesture tables) defines the complete set of signals; CTweakPlayerControl mappings read from a live dump give the commands that consume them; shards located the consumers. Game text (STRG in compressed paks) was not read, so prompts are inferred from the consumers.

signals.pointer: KPAD pos (+0x28/+0x2C after the smoothing filter, now bypassed): analog axes CFinalInput +0x6C/+0x74 (commands 2/3 turn, 55/56 pitch), digital zones via type-5 commands 20-23 (0x80061F1C, GUI 0x800D38C4), digital buttons 27-30 (0x803C31DC indices 6/7). Mouse.
signals.remote_depth: KPAD dist (+0x48): push/pull mechanisms read it from scripts. Keys E/Q.
signals.remote_roll: analyser [0xF] roll = asin(x/|xz|) -> buttons 31/32 past 45 degrees (0x803C31DC index 8); scripts read the twist. Keys Z/X (verified in game).
signals.remote_pitch: analyser [0x14] -> buttons 33/34 past 45 degrees (index 9). No default command; keys U/J added.
signals.remote_vertical_swing: table A entry 2 (0x803C11D8: low-passed Z range > 0.25*512 over 15 samples) -> command 50 -> CMorphBall 0x8010C928 -> 0x8010C9D4 spring jump. Key T; its flick was re-shaped to the 0.32 s half-sine (previous 0.18 s flick did not reach the threshold in the model).
signals.remote_horizontal_swing_and_jerk: table A entries 1 (lp x swing) and 0 (hp x); no default command. Produced by the shake key as a side effect.
signals.remote_deadband_flicks: table A entries 3-6 (0x803C0E40 detectors, thresholds 0 in the dumps); no default command.
signals.any_motion: table A entries 7 (remote) / 15 (Nunchuk): integrated deadbanded |a| > 0.01 (0x803C11AC) -> command 42 (type 4, A[7] or A[15]); consumer not located in the DOL player code (likely a grab/escape or script). Key G (held shake) sets both in the model.
signals.nunchuk_vertical_swing: table A entry 10 -> commands 28/29 (grapple lasso cast, CPlayer 0x80175B54/0x8017F124; pull, CLassoPoint 0x800DF758). Keys R/F (verified in game).
signals.nunchuk_horizontal_swing_and_jerk: table A entries 9 and 8; no default command.
signals.nunchuk_deadband_flicks: table A entries 11-14; no default command (entry 12 can never fire: integral is non-negative).
signals.nunchuk_roll: analyser [0xF] -> buttons 23/24 past 45 degrees (index 4). No default command; keys N/M added.
signals.nunchuk_pitch: analyser [0x14] -> buttons 25/26 (index 5). No default command; keys I/K added.
signals.orientation_windows: table B (12 entries from 0x803BE890 max/min ordering windows); no default command (type 6 unused in the dump).
signals.stick_directions: buttons 13-20 (indices 0-3) from the Nunchuk stick; keys WASD.

command_types_in_dump.note: Scripts can override command inputs at runtime (CControlMapper +0x68/+0xD4 table, 0x80062CC4); the keys above cover every physical signal the analyser can emit, so a scripted mapping still has a key.

implementation.runtime/include/hle/prime_keyboard_mouse: Keys RemotePitchUp/Down, NunchukTwistLeft/Right, NunchukPitchUp/Down as held tilts (same 90-degree ramp and Precision scaling as the twist); SpringFlick uses CastProfile.
implementation.runtime/src/hle/input/kpad.cpp: KPAD gravity vectors with roll and pitch for both devices: acc = (sin r cos p, -cos r cos p, sin p) + gestures; actions remote_up (U), remote_down (J), nunchuk_twist_left (N), nunchuk_twist_right (M), nunchuk_up (I), nunchuk_down (K).
implementation.tests: prime_lasso_gesture_tests: spring flick fires remote entry 2 and not the Nunchuk; held shake sets any-motion on both; tilt keys reach +-90 degrees and return. prime_wpad_packet_tests updated to the cast shape.

validation.in_game: pending: spring jump (T) in morph ball, shake (G) wherever the game asks, tilt keys when a prompt appears
